decisions.reason: The operator training programme builds directly on the firm's established service offer, had its own page in two consecutive years, and is central to the announced customer-support strategy, so management remains committed to it.
The fourth rotary axis accessory extends the firm's core machines at low incremental cost and fits the configurable-systems direction, so there is little reason to abandon it.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core business and only lightly promoted, but it embodies the publicly announced shift toward future-oriented production and materials processing, so management attributes weak uptake to market immaturity and persists.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is the firm's flagship core, backed by heavy R&D investment and visibly showcased, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The automatic tool change system is a visibly promoted, integral complement to the firm's milling machines that supports its productivity promise, so it remains on the market.
